DiscoveredResourceProfiles.description_en: The result of the resource list

ResourceCreationTime.description_en: The timestamp when the resource was created

ResourceDeleted.description_en:
The deletion status of the resource. Valid values:

1: Not deleted.

0: Deleted
ResourceDeleted.description_zh:
资源删除状态。取值：
1：未删除。
0：已删除

ResourceStatus.description_en:
The resource status. The status of a resource depends on the definition of each Alibaba Cloud service. This parameter may be empty.
For example:

When the resource type is ACS::ECS::Instance, because ECS instances are stateful, this parameter is Running or Stopped.

When the resource type is ACS::OSS::Bucket, because OSS buckets are stateless, this parameter is empty
ResourceStatus.description_zh:
资源状态。资源的状态取决于各云服务对其的定义，该参数可能为空。
例如：

当资源类型为ACS::ECS::Instance时，由于ECS实例有状态，因此该参数为Running或Stopped。

当资源类型为ACS::OSS::Bucket时，由于OSS Bucket无状态，因此该参数为空

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the resource list. Starting value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 资源列表的页码。起始值：1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。取值范围：1~100
